full_text:
Article 10 (Requests for Cooperation from Relevant Agencies, etc.)
(1) Where necessary for the efficient performance of its duties, the Committee may hear the opinions of relevant experts or request relevant administrative agencies and other agencies, corporations and organizations, etc. to cooperate by submitting materials or expressing opinions.
(2) Where necessary for the performance of its duties, the Committee may commission relevant experts, agencies, corporations or organizations to conduct investigations or research.
